_comment: Newest first. Rendered into changelog.html and changelog.xml by scripts/generate.mjs. type: new | improved | fixed. Links are site paths.

entries.title: Two new tools and faster pages

items.text: Colour converter: hex, RGB, HSL, HWB and OKLCH, with WCAG contrast and an sRGB gamut check
Cubic-bezier easing generator: drag the curve, preview it, copy cubic-bezier() or a linear() version
Faster pages: one variable font file per typeface instead of duplicates, deferred scripts, minified and long-cached CSS

entries.title: Four more effect recipes and keyboard fixes

items.text: Hover underline animations, including one that survives links wrapping onto two lines
3D flip cards that work with hover, keyboard focus and a button
Animating accordion height to auto: grid rows, interpolate-size and ::details-content
Animating the native dialog element in and out with @starting-style
The Smooth Accordion and Hamburger Morph animations can now be operated from the keyboard
CSS typewriter effect: the steps() and ch technique, multi-line typing and when to use JavaScript instead
Skeleton loading screens: layout-matched placeholders, a compositor-friendly shimmer and accessible loading states
Animated gradient borders: three techniques compared, animated with @property
Shake animation for form errors, with an accessible, reduced-motion-friendly version
CSS loading spinners: three lightweight techniques, delayed display and an accessible status
Fade in on scroll with CSS scroll-driven animations, plus a safe IntersectionObserver fallback
Animated gradient text that stays readable: contrast, forced colours and reduced motion
An infinite CSS marquee with a seamless loop and a proper pause control

entries.title: A new tool, three guides and an accuracy overhaul

items.text: CSS clamp() generator: fluid font sizes and type scales, with a check that 200% browser zoom still works
Guide: fluid typography with clamp(), with worked maths and zoom results
Guide: WCAG 2.2 colour contrast for developers, with 17 real colour pairs tested
Guide: robots.txt vs noindex vs canonical, and which to use when
The homepage is now a directory of every tool, with a quick filter
Rewrote the developer notes on all 16 tool pages; every code sample was run before publishing
Every animation's markup and CSS is now written out on its category page, and the JS tips library reads without JavaScript
Every page is available as Markdown for AI assistants and coding agents (add .md to any URL)
Microsoft Clarity now loads only after you accept cookies, and the privacy and cookie policies describe exactly what loads
Accessibility: labels on every form control, reduced-motion support and corrected heading levels
Around twenty factual errors across tools and guides, including what Search Console's "Discovered – currently not indexed" status means
The slug, text case and keyword tools now handle accented and non-English text (Straße → strasse, café stays café)
Six practical guides: indexing problems, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, dark mode, CSS animation performance and a launch checklist
Free browser-based SEO and CSS tools, a copy-paste CSS animation library, JavaScript tips, Dev Essentials and a React vs Angular comparison
